description: Trace why an export is considered used or unused. Returns file reachability, entry-point status, direct references, re-export chains, the framework plugin rules that mark the export as used (`plugin_credits`), and a concise reason string. If export_name is a class / enum / store MEMBER rather than a top-level export, returns a member trace instead (carrying member_name, member_kind, owner_export, owner_is_used) that reports the owning class's reachability and usage plus a pointer to the matching --unused-<kind>-members command, so a class-member finding can be debugged too. Use this when an agent needs evidence before deleting or rewriting a supposedly unused export or class member. References carry `search_visibility`; see fallow://tools/trace_export. When the config or FALLOW_TYPE_AWARE turns type-aware analysis on, the trace also carries a `semantic` block with checker-backed evidence, as `fallow dead-code --trace` does.

allow_remote_extends.description:
Allow trusted HTTPS config `extends` for this request. Defaults to false
and never grants process-global trust.

config.description: Path to a fallow config file.

export_name.description: Name of the exported symbol (or class/enum/store member) to trace.

file.description: Project-relative path to the file that declares the export.

production.description:
Production mode: exclude test, story, and dev files, only start/build
scripts, and report type-only dependencies.

root.description: Project root; defaults to the working directory.

threads.description: Parser thread count; defaults to CPU cores.

workspace.description: Workspace packages to analyze: name or repo-relative path, comma-separated list, globs, `!` negation.

name: trace_export
